description: This file defines a Dagger Hilt module interface 'FlavoredNetworkModule' that binds the implementation 'DemoNiaNetworkDataSource' to the interface 'NiaNetworkDataSource' for dependency injection within a singleton component. It is used for configuring network data sources in an Android project.

classes.name: FlavoredNetworkModule
classes.description: A Dagger module interface that binds a demo implementation of a network data source to its interface for dependency injection.

methods.name: binds
methods.description: Binds the 'DemoNiaNetworkDataSource' implementation to the 'NiaNetworkDataSource' interface for dependency injection.
